source: Names from Fighting Baseball (Super Famicom, 1994), used here only as the names of fictional spaceball players. No text, art, code, or data from that game is used. Never reference the real athletes the names distort: the joke is that they are nonsense.

players.name: Sleve McDichael
players.role: Hall of Famer. Sleve Bonzalez is named after him and Todd Bonzalez. Appears in the Loser Colosseum.

players.name: Onson Sweemey
lines: ROOKIE! I'M ONSON SWEEMEY. COACH. HOLOGRAM. LONG STORY.
PRESS ATTACK TO SWING THE BAT. AGAIN FOR A SECOND SWING. AGAIN FOR A HOME RUN.
THE THIRD SWING IS THE ONE THAT MAKES THE CRATES CRY.

players.name: Darryl Archideld
lines: DARRYL ARCHIDELD. CATCHER. I CATCH THINGS. MOSTLY COLDS.
HOLD THE MITT BUTTON TO CHARGE A SHOT. SOME TARGETS ONLY RESPECT COMMITMENT.
THE GLOWING BULLSEYE UP THERE? HIT IT WHEN YOU'RE READY. I'LL WAIT. I'M A HOLOGRAM.

players.name: Anatoli Smorin
lines: ANATOLI SMORIN. LAUNCHER. THAT STATUE IS HOLDING A SPACEBALL.
IT HAS A KOOZIE ON IT. THE KOOZIE IS LOAD-BEARING.
TAKE THE BALL. THE STATUE WON'T MIND. STATUES NEVER MIND. IT'S THEIR THING.

players.name: Rey McSriff
lines: REY MCSRIFF. BULLPEN. I WARM UP FOR A LIVING.
SEE THAT TALL SHAFT? KICK OFF ONE WALL, THEN THE OTHER. IT'S CALLED FRIENDSHIP.
THE SPACE MONKEYS SAY IT'S ACTUALLY CALLED A WALL KICK. THEY'RE VERY LITERAL.

players.name: Glenallen Mixon
lines: GLENALLEN MIXON. CONCESSIONS. I MIX THINGS.
THE POD BY THE DOOR SAVES YOUR GAME. IT ALSO UPGRADES YOUR GEAR, IF YOU HAVE GEMS.
I ALSO MIX DRINKS. THE DRINKS ARE NOT INCLUDED.

players.name: Kevin Nogilny
lines: KEVIN NOGILNY. GROUNDSKEEPER. THAT CRATER IS NOT MY FAULT.
YOUR SHIP DID THAT. THE FIELD WAS FINE. I HAD JUST MOWED IT.

players.name: Bobson Dugnutt
players.role: The face on the 1994 holo-foil card. Referees the Loser Colosseum. Playable in Bobson Mode.

players.name: Willie Dustice
lines: WILLIE DUSTICE. UMPIRE. I CALL 'EM AS I SEE 'EM.
AND I SEE THAT WALL. THAT WALL IS HOLLOW.
HIT IT WITH THE BAT. THREE TIMES. THE THIRD ONE'S THE CALL.

players.name: Scott Dourque
lines: SCOTT DOURQUE, ANNOUNCER. I NARRATE. YOU'RE WELCOME.
PAST THIS DOOR: FOUR TONS OF SPACE LUMBER. SAVE FIRST.

players.name: Dean Wesrey
lines: DEAN WESREY. MANAGER. I MANAGE. THAT'S THE WHOLE JOB.
WHEN A BOSS HITS ZERO YOU HAVE THREE SECONDS TO SIGN HIM. DOWN, DOWN-FORWARD, FORWARD, THEN ATTACK.
IT'S LIKE A FIGHTING GAME. I'VE PLAYED THEM ALL. I'M 40% THUMB.

players.name: Mike Truk
lines: MIKE TRUK. TEAM TRUCK. I CARRY THE EQUIPMENT.
THAT BIG CRATE? NOT MINE. I DON'T CARRY ANYTHING WITH TEETH.
THE SAVE POD IS BEHIND YOU. THE CRATE IS IN FRONT OF YOU. THIS IS THE WHOLE GAME.

players.name: Mike Sernandez
lines: MIKE SERNANDEZ. SCOUT. I'VE SEEN THINGS. MOSTLY THESE THINGS.
SCOUTING REPORT: KILL 200 OF ANY MONSTER AND IT GIVES YOU A PRESENT.
SPACE BATS TEACH ECHOLOCATION. ZOMBIES GIVE YOU BRAINS. THE HUNCH-BOT SEES THE LOOT. DON'T ASK HOW.

players.name: Todd Bonzalez
players.role: Sleve's uncle. Runs Todd's Card & Bait in Cyber-Mall 1996.
